change.description: Keep the local256 fixed-K source-F16 output-projection owner, but assign one adjacent K pair per thread, convert BF16 activations to FP16 in registers, load one FP16 weight pair, and accumulate native v_dot2_f32_f16 into FP32.
change.source_premise: llama.cpp Vulkan c0bc8591e uses vector-valued F16 dot work; hipEngine already transferred adjacent-output activation reuse, so this screen isolated the remaining native dot2 arithmetic premise.

lineage.reason: The optional external /home/lhl/amd-gpu-tuning/reference/atlas repository is absent.

red_green.red: The focused K6144/K9216 fixture failed because the requested halfdot wrapper did not exist.
red_green.green: Both natural fixed-K shapes completed against a direct FP32 CPU reference; maximum absolute error stayed within the predeclared 0.05 leaf envelope.
red_green.post_removal_validation: The kernel, ABI, wrapper, test, and diagnostic selector were removed after the natural-shape performance gate failed.

decision.reason: The candidate fails the all-natural-shapes-faster gate and models a 0.092-ms/token family regression. The exact non-temporal owner already streams both shapes at about 235 GB/s, so fewer arithmetic instructions do not increase the bandwidth ceiling.
decision.next_action: Do not transfer source-F16 dot2 into the fused output boundary. Attack a measured queue dependency or host feed gap instead.
